final_candidates.decision_summary: Q54R adds a positive charge in the basic TAR-binding domain and has modest evolutionary and sequence-model support.
K50R is a conservative basic-domain substitution likely to preserve TAR binding while slightly improving charge context.
K51R has a similar mechanistic rationale to K50R in the basic domain with comparable weak-to-modest evidence support.
